acceptance.assertion: With otherwise healthy local checks, repeatedly stale control-plane poll evidence yields an unhealthy probe whose reason is control-plane-poll-stale; unavailable, missing or timestamp-invalid poll evidence alone remains indeterminate.
Concrete local health or readiness failures remain unhealthy and are never masked by control-plane metric uncertainty or stale-poll classification.

The stale classification feeds exactly the existing failure threshold, restart budget, backoff, jitter and recovery-probe decision path; no new restart subsystem, timer, mutation authority or unbounded retry loop is added.
Focused tests cover stale, unavailable, missing, invalid-timestamp and concrete local-failure combinations, including threshold behavior and preservation of the existing restart budget.

The exact implementation revision passes full validation on supported Python versions, required focused tests, exact diff-bound self-review, required GitHub CI and all review findings are resolved or explicitly superseded before merge.

The reviewed pull-request head is merged through the canonical guarded path; post-merge main contains the reviewed head or an equivalent merge tree, and the final diff, merge commit, CI and review evidence are recorded.

T057 performs no deployment, service restart, timer replacement, host mutation, controlled stale-poll injection, connector snapshot refresh or live Grabowski runtime claim; those effects require dependent task T058 with runtime_mutation and break_glass authority.

approval.note: GitHub issue #477 authorizes the bounded repository correction. Codex P1 on superseded Bureau PR #1058 requires all deployment, service restart and live host verification to remain outside this task and under dependent runtime task T058.

goal: Treat repeatedly stale control-plane poll evidence as an unhealthy tunnel condition that enters Grabowski's existing bounded restart decision path, while unavailable, missing or timestamp-invalid poll evidence remains indeterminate and concrete local health or readiness failures retain precedence. This task changes and verifies repository state only; deployment and live restart-path proof are deferred to T058.

does_not_establish: authority to interrupt foreign work or release foreign leases

relation_to_timer_fix.scope: Independent calendar scheduling fix already installed and verified on the host; not modified or redeployed by T057.

review_correction.finding: Repository implementation and live runtime deployment require separate tasks and approval classes.

rollback.strategy: Revert the exact T057 implementation pull request and keep the currently deployed Grabowski runtime unchanged. Any later deployment rollback belongs to T058 and must restore the immediately previous commit-bound runtime.

title: Harden stale control-plane poll classification
